main_text.p: שמור חדש האביב ומזה אנחנו[?] Ecce Legislator instituit menses nostros ad visionem Lunæ, dixitque, Adhuc custodi mensem Spicarum, hinc nos intercalamus annum. Ibidem ait, sodales suos extra terram Israëlitæ[?]... Rabbanistarum intercalationes sequi, & cyclum novemdecim annorum: verùm ridet superstitiosas illorum τῶ[?] Adu, Badu, &c. observationes.

Sic existimo Judæos, stante Tempio, Pascha observâsse, primumque mensem instituisse, nec Deus in celebratione Paschatis ullam aliam rationem, quàm maturitatis spicarum jussit haberi, eo quod cùm Israëlitæ ex Ægypto exierunt, maturuerant. Judæi quoque Rabbanistæ & Talmudistæ licet alia admitterent, ut adnotavimus, hanc tamen paternarum traditionum non omnino obliti nunquam omittebant. Itaque saepe Tecupham Pascha subsequebatur, nonnunquam praecedebat. Interrogabor forsan, num Judæi cyclis in Paschatis supputatione ante Christum uterentur. Bre-

page.notes: The two Hebrew lines at the top are blurred. The first line reads as "שמור חדש האביב ומזה אנחנו" and the second as "עברין את השנה", but both are uncertain and marked [?]. The Greek "τῶ" before "Adu" is also uncertain. "Israëlitæ" and the Hebrew line were not fully legible, so the word after "Israëlis" is marked [?]; the printed form may read "Rabbanistarum" after a line-end hyphen. The catchword "vi di-" sits at the lower right below the last full line.
